components.name: Continue Panel
components.description: One broad featured book with a clear next action.
components.css: .ds-continue-panel{padding:24px;border:1px solid #ded8cc;border-radius:14px;background:#fdfbf7;color:#292c29}.ds-continue-panel span{font:500 12px Inter,Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#686b66}.ds-continue-panel h2{margin:12px 0 4px;font:400 36px 'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif}.ds-continue-panel p{margin:0 0 24px;color:#686b66;font:14px Inter,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-continue-panel button{height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#173f36;color:#fffdf8;font:500 14px Inter,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-continue-panel button:hover{background:#254f45}.ds-continue-panel button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #35675b;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: A personal library arranged like a well-kept reading list. Warm paper, deep green ink, and large literary type lead to a quieter page-centered reader.
keyCharacteristics: light, sepia, and dark reading surfaces

rules.name: Book First
rules.body: The book and next reading action lead; interface furniture recedes in the reader.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Use fine rules and tonal separation; reserve shadow for covers.

dos: Keep long-form text at a readable measure.
Retain covers in mobile library compositions.
donts: Add decorative dashboards or fake book content.
Let controls compete with the EPUB page.
